## HIV and end-stage liver and kidney disease

*Will cover:* why people with HIV develop end-stage liver disease and kidney failure together, and the role of viral hepatitis co-infection.

## Simultaneous liver–kidney transplantation

*Will cover:* what SLK transplantation is and when it is offered instead of liver transplantation alone.

## Transplantation in people with HIV

*Will cover:* how outcomes after liver and kidney transplantation in people with HIV have been reported, and what is not yet known for SLK recipients.

## Hepatitis C and the direct-acting antiviral era

*Will cover:* how direct-acting antivirals changed outcomes for transplant recipients with hepatitis C, and why the study compares eras.
